business_meaning: Surrogate key identifying the fact row for a savings-account snapshot.
documented_rules: Surrogate keys (*Sk) are the join keys between fact and dimension tables; every fact row has a surrogate PK.
inferred_rules: "Unique per row; not null; used as FK in downstream joins; surrogate keys should not change."

business_meaning: Natural/business account identifier (account number) for the snapshot.
documented_rules: AccountId/AccountNumber is the natural key — account number (used to relate facts to dimensions).
inferred_rules: Must be present for valid snapshots; should join to DimAccount (via AccountSk) for referential integrity; repeats across snapshot rows (one per date).

business_meaning: Surrogate key referencing the calendar date for this snapshot (links to DimDate.DateSk).
documented_rules: All *DateSk columns → DimDate.DateSk; DimDate.DateSk uses YYYYMMDD integer format.
inferred_rules: "Must exist in DimDate; should follow YYYYMMDD integer convention; represents the business date of the snapshot."

business_meaning: ETL load date/time when this snapshot row was loaded.
documented_rules: Every fact table ends with LoadDate (TIMESTAMP) recording ETL load time.
inferred_rules: "Must be populated; used for auditing; timezone not specified in docs (NOT_FOUND); LoadDate typically updated on initial load or when row is reprocessed depending on ETL policy (NOT_FOUND)."

business_meaning: Account balance associated with the snapshot/date (monetary amount).
documented_rules: FactAccount uses DECIMAL for CurrentBalance and FactAccountBalance uses DECIMAL for Opening/Closing balances.
inferred_rules: "Should be consistent with transaction running balances and daily reconciliation rules (e.g.
is_business_key: closing->next-day opening continuity where applicable); may be non-negative unless product permits overdraft (NOT_FOUND on overdraft policy)."

business_meaning: Interest rate applicable to the account at the snapshot date (annual %).
documented_rules: DimProduct defines InterestRate as DECIMAL and product interest should be used to derive interest amounts in facts; InterestAccrued in facts should reflect product's effective InterestRate.
is_business_key: should match the product's effective InterestRate as of DateSK (SCD2 temporal lookup); may be NULL if not captured in snapshot."
